triage.kind_span: 8,528,621 Shares of Common Stock Issuable Upon Exercise of Rights to Subscribe for Such Shares

subject_names.span: Liberty All-Star ® Growth Fund, Inc. (the “Fund”) is issuing non-transferrable subscription rights

subject_tickers.span: the new common shares issued in this offer will also be listed, on the NYSE under the symbol “ASG.”

security_class.span: 8,528,621 Shares of Common Stock Issuable Upon Exercise of Rights to Subscribe for Such Shares

rights_per_share.span: Record Date Shareholders will receive one Right for each common share held on the Record Date.

rights_per_new_share.span: For every five Rights held, a Record Date Shareholder is entitled to purchase one new common share of the Fund.

price_reference.span: The subscription price per common share (the “Subscription Price”) will be 95% of the lower of (i) the average of the last reported sales prices of a share on the NYSE on June 28, 2021 and the four days preceding the Expiration Date, or (ii) the net asset value (“NAV”) of a share on the Expiration Date.

price_pct.span: The subscription price per common share (the “Subscription Price”) will be 95% of the lower of (i) the average of the last reported sales prices of a share on the NYSE on June 28, 2021

record_date.span: its common shareholders of record as of May 24, 2021 (the “Record Date” and such shareholders,

expiration_date.span: The Offer will expire at 5:00 p.m., Eastern Time on June 28, 2021, unless the Offer is extended as described in this Prospectus

transferable.span: The Rights are non-transferable and will not be admitted for trading on the New York Stock Exchange (“NYSE”).

over_subscription.span: Record Date Shareholders who fully exercise their Rights may also, in certain circumstances, purchase additional common shares pursuant to an over-subscription privilege.

max_new_shares.span: These Rights will allow Record Date Shareholders to subscribe for new shares of common stock of the Fund (“common shares”) in an aggregate amount of approximately 8,528,621 common shares (the “Offer”).

notes: Non-transferable rights offering by a closed-end fund (424B1 prospectus dated 2021-05-24). Subscription price: 95% of the lower of (i) the average of the last reported NYSE sale prices on the expiration date and the four preceding days and (ii) NAV on the expiration date; estimated purchase price $7.69 and estimated subscription price $7.90 are illustrative. A secondary over-subscription of up to 25% of primary shares (10,660,776 shares in total) may be issued at the Fund's discretion; max_new_shares excludes it as the schema directs. Rights are rounded up to multiples of five per holder. The span for the fund name has the registered mark written as it appears across line breaks; max_new_shares span is joined across line breaks into single spaces.
